formative_worksheets.title: The Spinner and Mode Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming spinner predictions and complementary pairs.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can predict spinner outcomes and name complement pairs.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can predict spinner outcomes and name complement pairs.
header.character_watermark: Lucky in the top-right with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.prompt: Predict the spinner. Write the most likely outcome.

image_placeholders.description: A spinner illustration for a Grade 2 formative check. Spinner has 3/4 red + 1/4 blue. Below: 'Most likely: ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_SPINNER at Prompt 1: keywords name the visual element and criterion.

prompts.visual_layout: A single writing line below a question prompt asking the child to name the complement of HEADS.

image_placeholders.description: A single complement answer line for a Grade 2 formative check. Above: 'Heads — complement?'. Below: writing line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_COMPLEMENT at Prompt 2: keywords name the activity and target.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for a Grade 2 formative check.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.
